title: Lower bound for selecting outside a coordinate set
statement: Let $m$ be a positive natural number and let $J$ be a set of coordinates among the first $m+2^m$ positions, with $|J|\le 2^{m-1}$. Choose uniformly a sign vector on these positions and use its first $m$ signs to select one of the $2^m$ data positions. The probability that the selected data coordinate lies outside $J$ is at least $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates among the first $m+2^m$ positions
